scope: Windows 11 x64 development host, build 26300. Release and tests built from an extracted source ZIP. No production user profile or cloud provider used for this check.

source.excluded: 31 Git-visible promo screenshots, capture metadata and hosting configuration; ignored data and build outputs were not included.

build.dependencyCache: Prepopulated crates.io cache; build did not need a precompiled target or a network fetch.

cacheRegression.observedBefore: An optimized full-suite run failed at NameIndex::save, reporting Windows error 32. The staging file remained. The original locking process was not identified.
cacheRegression.controlledBefore: Holding the old cache open without delete sharing reproduced a failed replacement (Windows error 5).
controlledAfter: A briefly locked folder-size cache publishes the new value when the shared handle closes.
A persistently locked file-name cache returns an error, preserves previous bytes, leaves no extra file in the test directory and saves successfully after unlock.

limits: Identical ZIP reproduction applies to the source snapshot in the same packaging environment, not to independently linked Windows executables.
No clean Windows 10 or Windows 11 guest acceptance or authenticated cloud turn was claimed. RC6 and the earlier workspace-history preview were not replaced.
